actions.reason: The K3_C0001–K3_C0002 boundary is the weakest of the three pairs: native-geometry silhouettes are positive but small in all four modalities (CT 0.121, WSI 0.085, RNA 0.057, WXS 0.017) with negative fractions up to 0.45, and WXS shows essentially no within-versus-between distinction (median 0.0). Structurally the pair is conflicting rather than supportive: normalized-cut cost is the highest of the three pairs (0.657) indicating substantial cross-boundary connectivity, and the union is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.572), which is merge-compatible and cannot be read as preserving the boundary. By contrast, the K3_C0001–K3_C0003 boundary shows the strongest structural support (ARI 0.930, within 0.622 vs between 0.217, lowest normalized-cut 0.532, and a candidate_k=2 union resolution aligned with the current two-way structure), and the K3_C0002–K3_C0003 boundary is intermediate (ARI 0.698, within 0.557 vs between 0.234, normalized-cut 0.592). Because the weakest, most merge-compatible boundary is K3_C0001–K3_C0002, the provisional revision is to merge these two sets into a single unit, leaving the better-supported K3_C0001–K3_C0003 and K3_C0002–K3_C0003 boundaries intact for re-review.
